task_title: Complete foreign harness adapter contract for CF-006
task_criteria: Implement the remaining CF-006 adapter contract in this repository: every named adapter has a real --check and a named --apply refusal until measured; preserve the measured codex path and node manifest verification; add repository-local tests and documentation so the full selftest passes. Include a fresh ch:trace marker for CF-006.

items.criterion: Implement the remaining CF-006 adapter contract in this repository: every named adapter has a real --check and a named --apply refusal until measured; preserve the measured codex path and node manifest verification; add repository-local tests and documentation so the full selftest passes. Include a fresh ch:trace marker for CF-006.
items.detail: Most of the contract holds, but "every named adapter" does not. specs/HARNESS.md:100-101 names `aider` and `goose` in the adapter table, and specs/HARNESS.md:137 states the repo's own rule: "A harness named in the tables above with no adapter file is a FAIL, never a skip." `ls scripts/harness/` shows only harness-vars.sh, install-claude-code.sh, install-codex.sh, install-deepseek.sh, install-hermes.sh, install-opencode.sh, install-pi-agent.sh — no install-aider.sh / install-goose.sh — and tests/harness-conformance.sh:113-118 HARNESSES lists only hermes/claude-code/codex/opencode/opencode-v2/deepseek/pi-agent, so aider and goose produce no row at all (README.md:137 still says "aider and goose ship no adapter"). The repo's own audit names this exact gap and the fix: docs/handbook/appendices/units/39-specs-harness-md.md:219 "Add install-aider.sh/install-goose.sh, or delete both rows from specs/HARNESS.md:30. A spec row the battery cannot see is a claim with no refuter." No commit implements CF-006: `git log --all --grep=CF-006` returns only verdict/ch:trace bookkeeping (faf7a2b, a5c8bd2, a5579ef) plus older 0ec9634/c05880d/a32f234; the CF-006-W20261107 worker commit 893cf7a is "chore(gitreins): publish CF-097 verdict b427397d" with zero source diff, and faf7a2b's message says "Worker dispatch produced no source diff or commit". What DOES pass: all six existing adapters answer --check with named rows and a consistent verdict line (`bash tests/harness-node-e2e.sh` -> "PASS adapter:hermes/claude-code/codex/opencode/deepseek/pi-agent --check exits N with named row(s)", exit 0, "HARNESS-NODE-E2E: PASS"); the three unmeasured ladders refuse --apply by name (install-opencode.sh:137-139, install-deepseek.sh:95-97, install-pi-agent.sh:107-109) and the e2e proves exit 1 with nothing placed; the measured codex path is preserved (install-codex.sh:379-419 --check, :423+ --apply with `ok "binary" "$BIN"`, CF-006 comment at :470) and the node manifest verification is preserved (e2e arm 3: verify:green, verify:red-version, verify:red-binary, verify:null-version, verify:absent-manifest all PASS); repository-local tests pass (`bash tests/harness/opencode-install-test.sh` -> "OPENCODE ADAPTER: PASS", 22 pass; `bash tests/harness/claude-code-install-test.sh` -> PASS 39 passed; `bash tests/harness/vars-contract-test.sh` -> PASS 32 pass; `bash tests/harness/codex-install-test.sh --hermetic` -> "RESULT: PASS", 48 passed); the full suite passes (`bash tests/selftest.sh` -> "SELFTEST: PASS", /tmp/selftest.log:207, including §56 CF-006 node slice PASS and its red control PASS); and CF-006 ch:trace markers exist at tests/selftest.sh:3219, tests/selftest.sh:5448, tests/harness-node-e2e.sh:27, tests/harness/opencode-install-test.sh:3. Separately, the non-hermetic codex test is red on this host: `bash tests/harness/codex-install-test.sh` exits 1 with "FAIL C2 the real turn did not produce the artifact (rc=1)" even though the same run printed "PASS turn_exit — exit 0" and "PASS model_served" (tests/harness/codex-install-test.sh:336-341).
